scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "uv run todo server" "pnpm --dir front dev"
scripts.build:exe: pnpm --dir front build && uv run python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --noupx --onefile --name todo --distpath release --workpath build/pyinstaller --add-data "front/dist;dist" --collect-all uvicorn --collect-all fastapi --collect-all backend --collect-all webview --collect-all pythonnet --collect-all clr_loader backend/main.py
scripts.test:all: pnpm --dir front test && uv run python -m pytest backend/tests
